notes: Text is the MITECO consultation page only; the draft RD is a PDF annex not in the cache. Both versions code the same two consultation events correctly and code no thresholds. Both explicitly considered and excluded the 15% best-performance requirement because it appears only in the page's descriptive background (not an operative provision; cf. codebook edge case 6.6); the reference (written blind) counts it, so both miss it equally. Both correctly attribute the 500 kW cutoff to Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1364.
